ctx.x: Bobby Lee he was a very famous out in Philadelphia. And New Jersey. He was a pianist, he looked just like a white -- very white and he had a band called Bobby Lee's Cottonpickers. And he had -- he played at the Sea Girt Inn, in Sea Girt, New Jersey every year. That's where we worked with Bobby. The first week I played at the Cinderella Inn in Philadelphia with him.
